message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time) is usually **8–9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time), depending on daylight‑saving rules:

| Period | Los Angeles | Berlin | Difference |
|--------|-------------|--------|------------|
| Standard time (winter) | PST (UTC−8) | CET (UTC+1) | +9 h |
| Daylight saving (summer) | PDT (UTC−7) | CEST (UTC+2) | +9 h |

So when it’s noon in Los Angeles, it’s 9 p.m. in Berlin. If you’re planning a call, double‑check the current dates for DST transitions, as they don’t always align exactly.
